image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of an orangutan sitting on a tree stump or log. The orangutan is wearing a beige burlap sack over its head like a hood. It has long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and a broad face with visible cheek pads. The background consists of blurred earthy tones and tree trunks. A prominent 'iStockphoto' watermark overlays the center of the image.
